Camila / Emily — Rafael from Redwood Legal here. I reviewed the MSA/DPA and added inline comments to the MSA redline. Summary of material asks:
1) Narrowing the indemnity reciprocity (we ask for consequential-damage carveouts).
2) Data processing: we propose a clause that limits processed customer data to tokenized inference inputs + KV cache; logging retention max 90 days unless customer specifies otherwise.
3) Audit rights: agree but propose quarterly cadence and reasonable notice.
4) SOW: attached a Redwood_SOW_Template.docx with a short pilot scope section — please insert project milestones and acceptance criteria under Section 2.

I flagged a potential sticking point on export control language in Section 12; please have your counsel confirm. Happy to take the 1/19 call and walk the redlines live.

Rafael / Camila — thanks for the quick turnaround. Our outside counsel reviewed your redlines and returned a couple counter proposals (attached). High level:
- We cannot accept the expanded indemnity carveout as written — our counsel requests a narrower limitation on consequential damages carveout and an exception for third-party claims arising from misuse of integration endpoints.
- Regarding data retention: 90 days is acceptable for logs, but we need a tag-based retention exception for customer-specific audit trails (60-180 days depending on customer contract).
- On export control, Orion Lens prefers the original language; we can add a joint-compliance clause instead of rewriting the export control paragraph.

I've attached OrionLens_MSA_Redline_v2.docx with tracked changes. We are targeting a signed MSA+DPA by end of the month to begin pilot work in February. If any of these are non-starters, flag them now so we can escalate.

Attachments: OrionLens_MSA_Redline_v2.docx

Best,
Emily Jones
Head of Partnerships, Orion Lens
